A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize given form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a usable equivalent form before subtracting, such as simplifying a fraction part, converting an improper mixed-number part to a standard mixed number, or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard mixed number.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction inside a mixed number before subtraction.
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for converting fractions to equivalent fractions solely to match denominators; that is S02.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is S05.
Do not tag when no preliminary rewriting is performed.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are rewritten as equivalent fractions to share a denominator.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no denominator-matching conversion is needed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as having 0 over a denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag for simplifying a final fraction after subtraction; that is S06.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with equal denominators.
Tag when the fraction subtraction occurs inside a mixed-number problem after any needed setup.
Tag whether the result is positive, zero, or initially negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding or creating a common denominator; that is S02.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts; that is S04.
Do not tag for the borrowing adjustment after a negative fractional result; that is S05.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the two quantities when solving a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction problem.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2.
Tag when one quantity has an implied whole part of 0 and the solution subtracts whole parts.
Tag whether the whole-part subtraction is done before or alongside fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction items with no whole-number components.
Do not tag for borrowing one whole from the whole part; that is S05.
Do not tag for combining the final whole and fractional results into one answer; that is S06.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag for both mixed-number subtraction and whole-minus-fraction cases requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag for ordinary fraction subtraction after regrouping unless the step explicitly performs the borrow; the subtraction itself is S03.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a non-reduced fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when zero-valued fractional parts are collapsed to a whole number or 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or fraction answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction steps themselves; those are S03 and S04.
Do not tag for preliminary normalization before subtraction; that is S01.
Do not tag merely because an answer is already in simplest form unless the step explicitly states the final combined or simplified result.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize given numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a usable equivalent form before subtraction, such as converting a whole number to a whole plus fractional part or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a solution normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when the rewrite is done to make whole-part and fraction-part subtraction possible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for converting fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator; that is denominator alignment.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag when no explicit rewrite or normalization is performed.

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when a solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag even if the denominators are already equal but the step explicitly states that the fraction parts are already in that denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already share a denominator and no denominator-alignment step is shown.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction after subtraction.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are in compatible form, including same-denominator fractions or the fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution subtracts numerators of fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a solution subtracts the fractional parts of mixed numbers.
Tag whether the fractional result is positive, zero, or negative before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts only.
Do not tag for the borrowing adjustment step that fixes a negative fractional part after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the quantities, including whole parts of mixed numbers or a whole number minus zero whole parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when a mixed number is subtracted from a whole number and the whole-part subtraction is shown.
Tag whether the whole-part subtraction occurs before or alongside fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for fraction subtraction alone.
Do not tag for combining a final whole and fractional result into one mixed number.
Do not tag when the item contains only simple fractions and no whole-part subtraction is performed.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference or anticipating one.
Tag when the borrowed whole is added to the existing fractional part before re-subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is normalization.
Do not tag when no regrouping from the whole part occurs.
Do not tag for ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts that does not require borrowing.

skills.name: Simplify and compose
skills.definition: Express the final result in lowest terms and in an appropriate final form, such as a simplified fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 = 3/4 or 0/3 = 0.
Tag when a solution combines computed whole and fractional parts into a mixed number or integer final answer.
Tag when the final step recognizes that a zero fractional part leaves a whole number only.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction steps themselves.
Do not tag for denominator alignment or normalization before subtraction.
Do not tag for intermediate unsimplified results that are not yet put into final form.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, common-denominator conversion, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard number form into a standard equivalent form before subtraction, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard mixed number or simplifying a fraction part inside a mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a mixed number with an improper fractional part, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a step simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtracting, such as 3 4/10 to 3 2/5.
Tag when the rewriting changes representation but not value in order to make later subtraction straightforward.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is handled by S02.
Do not tag finding a common denominator between two separate fractions; that is handled by S03.
Do not tag final simplification of an answer after subtraction; that is handled by S06.

skills.name: Represent whole as fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed or fractional form with zero fractional part using the needed denominator so it can be subtracted componentwise.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the denominator is chosen to match the other fraction or mixed number in the problem.
Tag when this representation enables whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag conversion between unlike denominators for two non-whole fractions; that is handled by S03.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that is handled by S01.
Do not tag borrowing after a negative fractional difference appears; that is handled by S05.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag in mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator; that is handled by S02.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction; that is handled by S06.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately in mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when mixed numbers are subtracted componentwise as whole part minus whole part and fraction part minus fraction part.
Tag even if the fractional difference is zero or negative before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the prior step of making denominators match; that is handled by S03.
Do not tag the borrowing adjustment used after a negative fractional result; that is handled by S05.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification alone without an actual subtraction operation.

skills.name: Borrow across whole-fraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full fraction unit and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step reduces the whole part by 1 and adds one denominator-unit fraction, such as 1 becoming 0 and 5/5 being added to the fraction part.
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial negative fractional difference in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problem.
Tag whether the borrowed unit is written as denominator over denominator or added to an existing fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag finding a common denominator before borrowing; that is handled by S03.
Do not tag final combination of the adjusted whole and fraction parts; that is handled by S06.

skills.name: Compose and simplify result
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts into the final answer and reduce any fraction or zero-valued fraction to lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step combines a whole part and a fraction part into a mixed number or fraction result.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer result, such as 1 and 0 becoming 1.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself; that is handled by S04.
Do not tag normalization before subtraction; that is handled by S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping; that is handled by S05.
